title: According to and In Line With: de acuerdo con, conforme a, según
goal: Name a source with de acuerdo con and say that something follows a rule with conforme a.
grammar: de acuerdo con, conforme a, según

items: I can use *de acuerdo con* and *según* to name a source.
I can use *conforme a* to say that something follows a rule or a plan.
I can choose between the three according to what I want to say.
